1.consolidated_definition: Dinero extraordinario, dado a los empleados en diciembre. Aguinaldo o bono de Navidad.
1.en_consolidated_definition:
Year-end bonus or Christmas gift given to employees in December.

Alternatively, it can be referred to as a Christmas bonus or an end-of-year gratuity.

Note: In some Latin American countries, including Puerto Rico, this payment is also known as "aguinaldo" which translates to "Christmas gift".
